# pr-legislative-x402

> An HTTP API and MCP server for Puerto Rico legislative data (Asamblea Legislativa), paid per call with the x402 agent-payment standard. The hosted demo serves 3 sample records with payments off. The full paid corpus is not live yet.

Maintained by Carlos Jimenez (CDVolvik) at R21 Digital. MIT licensed.

## API
- [OpenAPI description](https://pr-legislative-x402.vercel.app/openapi.yaml): endpoints, parameters, responses
- GET /health: liveness check, free
- GET /v1/preview: corpus counts only, free
- GET /v1/bills/search?q=&chamber=&status=&limit=: summary rows, 25 at most, $0.01 per call once payments are on
- GET /v1/bills/:identifier: full detail (abstract, sponsors, action history), $0.03 per call once payments are on

## MCP server
- Tools: search_pr_legislation, get_pr_bill
- [Setup](https://github.com/CDVolvik/pr-legislative-x402#use-it-from-an-agent-mcp)
